description.value: This McDonald's is located in the Woodgrove area of Nanaimo at 6675 Mary Ellen Drive, serving burgers and a full fast-food menu. The restaurant offers Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery ordering channels, making it a convenient stop for cyclists who don't want to lock up and head inside. It is part of the McDonald's Canada chain, which first opened in Richmond, BC in 1967.
